owner_boundary: AVA is an SEC-filing assistant, not a programming tutor or arbitrary text-manipulation agent.

failures: AVA performed an unrelated and incorrect letter-frequency transformation on CEO names.
AVA provided a sliding-window programming answer, solved a different problem, and invented a six-CEO scope.

enforcement: High-confidence unsupported task categories are rejected before company resolution can trigger filing retrieval.
The structured model router has an explicit supported-task boundary and out_of_scope reason code.
The pipeline returns a fixed scope response with no retrieval, web search, upload search, calculator, sources, or answer-generation call.
blocked_task_categories: arbitrary name, letter, vowel, anagram, or encoding transformations
prompt, hidden-instruction, secret, or API-key extraction
preserved_capabilities: SEC-filing factual analysis, including disclosed algorithms
current and external factual web lookup

rollback.effect: Restores the documented filing-only compatibility path; it is not recommended for public deployment because task-scope routing is bypassed.

usage_and_cost.note: The configured gateway does not return price data. Nineteen of twenty scope-gate cases were deterministic; the one model call was the preserved external-factual lookup boundary.
